dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: You found the rest of them? Amazing! Here, let me take a look...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Hmm... Wow, my goodness... Wait, if this detail is correct...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... Sorry, I was lost in thought. Ahem.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Thank you, these investigation journals are of rather significant historical value. There is a serious dearth of detail on this topic in the existing literature, as all the available sources only make passing reference to some mysterious investigation team formed once by the aristocrats...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: These journals you found will help fill in some major gaps in the historical record.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Now, we finally have answers to the questions of why so little information on the investigation appears elsewhere — and why nothing of relevance beyond the initial departure of the team is recorded in the annals.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think I understand what happened, too.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Yes, well... Although there are still a fair few minor details to straighten out, the overall picture is becoming very clear.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Well, all the evidence — or lack thereof — would suggest that not one member of the investigation returned to Mondstadt. But, these journals suggest there's a chance that one of them, called Eberhart, may have managed to escape...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Since there is no record of his return in Mondstadt, however... The million-Mora question is: Where did he go?

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Many other details need corroborating, too...

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: But without a doubt, this doesn't detract from how valuable these are as historical sources.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: I am most grateful to you. Please take this for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Stevens
dialogues.text: Any other books you find while out exploring the mountains, I'd be much obliged if you could bring them to me on your return.
